description:
Add the sphinx-tags extension to enable tag-based navigation and discovery
across 201 documentation files. This includes infrastructure setup, a controlled
vocabulary taxonomy of 40 tags, and systematic tagging of all pages.

Key decisions made during planning:
- Tags placed after the H1 title in all documents
- Index files get minimal tags only (1-2 category tags)
- All 38 Python API RST files will be fully tagged
- Badge colors coordinated with Furo theme
